facts.text: The Stone Chariot stands inside the Vittala Temple complex at Hampi.
It is a shrine dedicated to Garuda, the vehicle (vahana) of Vishnu.
It is attributed to the Vijayanagara king Krishnadevaraya and dated to the 16th century. The attribution and date should be confirmed against an ASI publication before use in the project report.
Hampi is inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site (listing no. 241), Group of Monuments at Hampi. Confirm the inscription year and criteria on the UNESCO page.

facts.text: The Lotus Mahal is in the Zenana (Zanana) Enclosure at Hampi (Kamalapuram area), Karnataka.
It is also known as Chitragni Mahal.
It is described as one of the finest architectural structures of the Vijayanagara Empire.
